Meridian Constructors & Co. 
 
 Office of the Executive Engineer · Delhi · IN 
 
 
 No. CC/30/2016/099 
 Dated: March 31, 2026 
 
 Certificate of Completion of Work 
 
 This is to certify that the work of "Flyover - Delhi Pkg-99" (bridges flyovers), awarded to M/s
 National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN NAICC4417O) , has been completed
 in all respects on May 18, 2016 at a gross executed value of INR 23,16,00,000/- (Rupees 23.16 Crore
 
 Only). 
 The work has been completed in all respects as per the approved drawings, specifications, and
 
 contract conditions. The quality of work has been found satisfactory during the final inspection carried
 out by the undersigned. 
 
 The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Tanvir Menon. This certificate is issued for record
 and for submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past
 performance. 
 
 
 
 Executive Engineer 
 
 Meridian Constructors & Co.
